Class BankAccountSelector

public inherited sharing class BankAccountSelector

Selector for BankAccount__c. Centralizes SOQL access to bank-account records and exposes results through a typed Result inner class that extends QueryResult, so callers receive consistent error and record-list handling across all queries.

Group:
    Selector Classes

Since:
    08/09/2021

Version:
    2.0


Change Log

  • 08/09/2021 - v1.0 - Initial version.
  • 08/10/2021 - v1.1 - Adds method getBankAccountById() and several fields to getBankAccountByCode().
  • 08/24/2021 - v1.2 - Adds method getBankAccountByExternalId().
  • 08/29/2021 - v1.3 - Adds additional fields to method getBankAccountById().
  • 08/30/2021 - v1.4 - New methods getBankAccountsByType() and getBankAccountsByVenue().
  • 10/25/2023 - v1.5 - getBankAccountByExternalId(): adds field MainContact__c.
  • 05/09/2026 - v2.0 - Result extends QueryResult (previously Tools.QueryResult). API version upgraded to 66.0. getBankAccountById(): adds fields EffectiveExternalId__c and IsDefault__c.

Members

  Modifiers and Type Name Description
public static BankAccountSelector.Result
getBankAccountByCode(String bankAccountCode)
Returns the BankAccount__c record matching the given code, including its parent Account__c billing-address fields and the bank account's own address fields.
public static BankAccountSelector.Result
getBankAccountByExternalId(String bankAccountId)
Returns the BankAccount__c record matching the given external Id, used when reconciling records originated by external systems (payment processors, etc.).
public static BankAccountSelector.Result
getBankAccountById(String bankAccountId)
Returns the BankAccount__c record matching the given Id with the full set of fields required for downstream processing (account, routing, contact, status, address, and record-type information).
public static BankAccountSelector.Result
getBankAccountsByType(String typeName)
Returns active BankAccount__c records of the given record type, including the IsDefault__c flag so callers can identify the default account for that type.
public static BankAccountSelector.Result
getBankAccountsByVenue(String venueId)
Returns active BankAccount__c records related to the given venue Account__c, including the IsDefault__c flag so callers can identify the venue's default account.
